audit: 2026-09-08 scheduled remote agent p4: 50 Qs in one batch across all four topics (Medicine 14, Obstetrics and Gynaecology 13, Psychiatry 13, Paediatrics 10), published as ten 5-question files to stay inside the tool payload limit. Per-question deficit selection was run on the active L3 to L5 tier, following the p3 precedent, because the closed legacy L1 and L2 inventory of about 25 to 30 per cent per topic makes the whole-topic denominator unreachable. Every topic entered the run at 49.3 per cent L3, 44.3 per cent L4 and 6.3 to 6.4 per cent L5, so L5 again sat above its 5 per cent target in all four topics and none was generated. L3 and L4 deficits were tied to within 0.08 percentage points across all eight remaining cells, so ties were broken toward the lower-total modules per the equal-module-balance directive, giving 26 L3 and 24 L4 and zero L1 or L2. Correct-letter distribution A10 B10 C10 D10 E10; worst option length parity 1.27 across all 50 with the correct option the longest in 20; zero non-ASCII characters, zero em-dashes and zero banned tokens; every rationale carries an inline source and every source_ref matches a label in that question sources array; no stem or id duplicates against the existing bank; every stem positions the candidate as the treating doctor; no lead-in guideline leaks, no pertinent-negative parentheticals in any correct option, no follow local guidelines non-options and no stem carries more than two chained pertinent-negative closures; stems run 119 to 149 words with paragraph breaks and all tags are drawn from the existing vocabulary.
